name: CENTERLINE
description: Create an associative centre line from two selected line segments, or pick the missing sources interactively. Parallel lines produce a midline; intersecting lines produce their angle bisector. ALTERNATE chooses the other bisector. Extents cover projected source endpoints plus a default 0.25 m extension, editable in properties. Source edits update the line; source endpoint reversal preserves the bisector. Escape cancels without edits; one completed line is one undo step. MCP point picks use targetId. Supports shared rendering, clipboard, transforms, centre maintenance and archive persistence.

name: CENTERREASSOCIATE
description: Reassociate selected unlocked centre marks or centre lines with a circle/arc source ID for marks or two line source IDs for centre lines. No input starts an interactive source pick; Escape cancels. Preserves IDs and appearance. Atomic, one undo step.

name: CENTERDISASSOCIATE
description: Detach selected unlocked centre marks or centre lines, keeping exact local source snapshots. No arguments. Marks retain their position and appearance when the source is edited or deleted. Atomic, one undo step.

name: CENTERRESET
description: Reset selected unlocked centre marks or centre lines to default size, extension and primary bisector and apply the current dimension style without overrides. Retains source associations or detached snapshots and stable IDs. No arguments; atomic, one undo step.

name: DIMBREAK
description: Add manual visual gaps to selected unlocked dimensions. Input x1 y1 x2 y2 projects two world points onto the line/arc nearest the first point, on each selected dimension. REMOVE clears all gaps. Maximum 128 gaps per dimension. Intervals follow the relative position along the styled primitive as geometry changes; measurement and associations remain intact. Shared model/print/SVG rendering, atomic edit and one-step undo. No input or MANUAL starts two snapped point picks with live preview; coordinate input and MCP point actions are supported. Escape cancels without edits. AUTO [gap in metres [source IDs...]] enables dynamic intersection gaps against supported curve sources (lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, splines, polylines, rectangles, polygons, hatch/region boundaries). Without IDs uses current visible supported objects; without gap uses text size. Retains manual gaps; REMOVE clears both. Referenced-object movement/deletion updates gaps at render time. Up to 1000 sources, 128 automatic gaps and 100000 primitive pairs; excessive requests fail atomically. Other dimensions are supported using their styled lines/arcs and manual gaps. Their automatic gaps, labels and markers are excluded to avoid recursive or cyclic evaluation. Block-reference obstacles are resolved from transformed children, including nested blocks and local dimensions (maximum depth 16); hidden child layers are excluded.

name: DIMSPACE
description: Space selected unlocked parallel linear dimensions or concentric angular dimensions. Input: [distance in metres|AUTO] [BASE dimensionId]. The base is the first selected ID unless explicit. It remains unchanged. On each side of the base, dimensions are ordered by existing distance and spaced evenly; zero aligns them. AUTO uses twice the largest selected text size. Keeps sources, values, custom text placement and styles; rejects mixed/nonparallel/nonconcentric or invalid inward radii atomically. One undo step. POINT [BASE dimensionId] starts a snapped point pick with live preview: gap is the perpendicular distance from the base dimension line, or radial distance from its arc. Coordinate input and MCP point actions are supported; a numeric distance or AUTO also completes this stage. Escape cancels without edits.

name: DIMTEDIT
description: Place selected unlocked dimension labels independently of the measured geometry. No input (or POINT) starts a snapped interactive point with live preview; point actions and coordinate input commit, Escape cancels. POSITION x y sets the world position in metres; ANGLE degrees sets the text angle (displayed upright); HOME resets position and angle to automatic. Preserves label content, measurement, style and associativity; atomic and undoable.

name: DIMEDIT
description: Edit the label of selected unlocked dimensions without changing their measured geometry. Input NEW "text" replaces the label; <> inside the text expands to the current formatted measurement (including symbols/tolerances/alternate units). HOME restores the automatic label. ROTATE degrees sets the label angle. OBLIQUE degrees sets the world angle of extension lines on linear dimensions; OBLIQUE AUTO restores perpendicular extensions. Parallel extension directions and non-linear selections are rejected atomically. Text is bounded to 16384 characters. Inspection labels/rates are retained; updates are atomic and undoable.

name: DIMDISASSOCIATE
description: Detach selected unlocked dimensions from their sources without changing their current measured geometry, IDs or style. No input. Linear/angular/ordinate dimensions retain native defining points; radius/arc-length/center marks retain a bounded local curve snapshot. Sources can then change or be deleted independently. One undo step.

name: DIMREASSOCIATE
description: With no input, pick a new source in the canvas (or supply point actions with targetId); angular dimensions accept an arc or two intersecting line picks. Escape cancels without edits. Associate selected unlocked dimensions to input source entity IDs: one compatible curve or two intersecting line IDs for angular dimensions. All selected dimensions must support the supplied source(s). Replaces detached snapshots and former links, retaining style and placement parameters; validates atomically and commits one undo step.

name: DIMUPDATE
description: Apply the current dimension style (or input a quoted style name/ID) to selected unlocked dimensions, resetting their overrides in one undo step. Geometry/associations remain intact.

name: DIMREGEN
description: Refresh selected unlocked dimensions from their linked styles, preserving overrides and validating geometry. With no selection, process all editable model dimensions. No input. Refreshes block bounds; one undo step.

name: DIMINSPECT
description: Set an inspection frame on selected unlocked dimensions. Input: ON ["label" ["rate"]] or OFF. Label/rate maximum 256 characters. Keeps geometric associations; stored as a format override and undoable.

name: DIMSTYLE
description: Named dimension styles. No input opens the style panel and lists styles. RENAME "old" "new" preserves the style ID. SAVE "name" copies the selected dimension or current style; CURRENT "name" selects a style; APPLY "name" applies it to selected unlocked dimensions; DELETE "name" removes an unused inactive custom style. SET "name" TEXT|ARROWSIZE|GAP|OVERRUN metres, ARROW tick|closed|open|none, PRECISION 0..8, PREFIX|SUFFIX "text" edits a style and refreshes linked model/nested dimensions while preserving overrides. SET also accepts TOLERANCE none|symmetric|deviation|limits; TOLUPPER/TOLLOWER nonnegative metres (radians for angular dimensions), TOLPRECISION 0..8; ALTERNATE ON|OFF, ALTUNIT m|cm|mm|in|ft, ALTPRECISION 0..8; INSPECTION ON|OFF, INSPECTLABEL/INSPECTRATE text (256 characters maximum). Geometry and associations are retained; one undo step.

name: ATTEXT
description: Export model block attributes, including nested occurrences, to CSV or lossless JSON. Input: [CSV|JSON] [ALL|SELECTED] [TO "absolute path.csv/json"]. Defaults: CSV ALL, native save dialog or browser download. Includes hidden, invisible, constant and locked instances; selected scope traverses selected model roots. CSV strings are protected against spreadsheet formula execution. No drawing/history changes; close BEDIT first.

name: BATTMAN
description: Manage block attribute definitions. No input or a block name opens the Blocks palette; expand Attribute manager. Input: "block name" TAG TAG|PROMPT|DEFAULT "value", CONSTANT|INVISIBLE ON|OFF, or UP|DOWN|DELETE. Renaming migrates every reference value, including nested/locked instances, in one undo step. Defaults preserve existing variable values; constants update. Duplicate tags and broken dependencies are rejected. Close BEDIT before changing definitions.

name: ATTDEF
description: Define an attribute as native text in the current model or BEDIT draft. No input opens the definition form in the Blocks palette. Input: TAG "default value" x y [HEIGHT metres] [PROMPT "label"] [CONSTANT] [INVISIBLE]. Tags are unique within the current definition, uppercase, 1–64 letters/digits/underscore/hyphen starting with a letter. Select the created text together with geometry when running BLOCK. One undo step.

name: ATTEDIT
description: Edit a field on selected unlocked block references. Input: TAG "value"; constants and missing tags reject the entire operation. Without input opens selection properties. Each insertion has its own values. One undo step.

name: ATTSYNC
description: Synchronize attribute values of references to a named block (optional quoted name or ID), or to blocks identified by selected references. Preserve existing values by tag, initialize new fields, refresh constants and remove obsolete fields. Includes nested references; locked model references are unchanged. One undo step.

name: ATTDISP
description: Set attribute display to NORMAL, ALL (alias ON), or OFF. NORMAL respects invisible definitions; ALL reveals them; OFF hides all attribute values. Affects block rendering and snapping, including printing. One undo step.

name: WBLOCK
description: Export a local .lcad block library. Input: [name|LIBRARY|SELECTION] [TO "absolute/file.lcad"]. Empty input exports selection or the whole drawing relative to BASE. Named definition export includes nested definitions and resources; LIBRARY includes all named definitions. With no TO path opens Save As. Does not replace the active document. Close BEDIT first.

name: BLOCKIMPORT
description: Import reusable blocks from a .lcad library or ordinary drawing. Optional absolute path; otherwise opens a file chooser. Merges definitions, assets, layers and text styles without replacing model entities, resolving name/ID conflicts. One undo step. Ordinary drawings become a block relative to their BASE. INSERT FILE [path] imports then starts insertion of the first entry. Close BEDIT first.

name: BASE
description: Set the document insertion base point in metres. Input: x y, or omit input to pick/type a point. Does not move geometry. One undo step; Escape cancels. Close BEDIT first.

name: BEDIT
description: Open an isolated editable draft of a block. Input is a block name or ID (optional quotes); without input select one unlocked reference. Regular drawing commands, local selection and undo/redo operate on its local children. The saved document/autosave remain unchanged until BSAVE or BCLOSE SAVE. Draft content/assets are exposed in editor.blockEdit; document remains the saved model. Nested editing and replace_document are refused until BCLOSE.

name: BSAVE
description: Validate and save the current block-edit draft, updating every reference in one model undo step while keeping the editor open. Stable IDs, nested bounds, new resources and styles are retained. Cycles or broken child dependencies leave the draft open and the model unchanged. Resets the local undo baseline after a successful save.

name: BCLOSE
description: Close the block editor. Input SAVE (default) validates/applies the draft first; DISCARD abandons changes since the last BSAVE. A failed save leaves the editor open. Escape cancels only the active drawing command, not the edit session. Closing returns selection to model references.

name: BSEARCH
description: Open the reusable block palette. Optional input filters named definitions by case-insensitive name substring. The palette can create a block from the selection and start interactive insertion.

name: BLOCK
description: Create a named reusable block from the selected unlocked entities and their dependencies. Input: "name" [baseX baseY] [KEEP] [REDEFINE]. Omit coordinates to pick/type the base point; omit input to enter a name first. By default converts the source selection to one reference at the same position. KEEP retains source entities. REDEFINE updates an existing definition without changing its ID and refreshes all reference bounds. Cycles, locked dependencies and conversion that would break outside associations are rejected. One undo step; Escape cancels.

name: INSERT
description: Insert a named block on the active unlocked visible layer. Input: "name" [x y [positiveUniformScale [angleDegrees]]]. Names with spaces require quotes. Without coordinates, pick/type the insertion point with a preview; SCALE value and ROTATION degrees change the pending transform. ATTRIBUTE TAG "value" sets a pending variable attribute before placement, with preview and a single insertion undo step. The Blocks palette also offers values for the next insertion. No input prompts for the name. Native child geometry and linked resources are retained. One undo step; Escape cancels.

name: TRANSPARENCY
description: Apply an object transparency override (0 opaque through 90 percent transparent) to selected unlocked entities, including reference images. Requires one numeric value; one undo step. Source image alpha and per-image opacity are retained.

name: IMAGEATTACH
description: Attach a linked image in native Tauri. Input is an absolute source path (spaces allowed, optional quotes); omit it for a native file dialog. Supported PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/SVG, maximum 25 MiB and 64 megapixels. Creates one image with a cached embedded snapshot in one undo step. No automatic disk reads on opening a drawing.

name: IMAGE
description: Select one unlocked image. Without input opens the shared image editor. LINK or RELINK [absolute path] replaces its source, or opens a native dialog if omitted. RELOAD reads the linked source explicitly. EMBED removes the link, retaining its last snapshot. Native source reads are bounded; failure leaves the old image intact. Identity, placement, rotation, opacity, crop and colour adjustments survive reload; undo restores source and snapshot. Browser mode supports inspecting cached snapshots and EMBED.

name: WIPEOUT
description: Create a white masking polygon above existing entities without deleting them. Selected sources must form one simple closed straight-edged contour. Without selection or input POINTS, point actions/typed x,y append 3..128 vertices with preview; Enter/DONE commits, UNDO removes the last vertex, Escape cancels. FRAME ON/OFF changes selected editable masks; the shared panel also controls the frame. Masks are native closed point polylines with wipeout metadata, transform/clipboards/archive normally, and use DRAWORDER for stacking. The frame is included in print when enabled.

name: DRAWORDER
description: Reorder selected editable model entities. Input FRONT (default), BACK, FORWARD or BACKWARD; ABOVE/BELOW then require a point action targeting another visible entity via targetId or hit-testing. Selected and unselected relative order is stable. Locked/hidden entities cannot move. Escape cancels reference picking; effective changes use one undo step and persist in the entity array.

name: TEXTTOFRONT
description: Bring all editable text and/or dimension annotations to front, preserving relative order. Input TEXT, DIMENSIONS or ALL (default). Does not require a selection. One undo step only if order changes.

name: IMAGECLIP
description: Select one unlocked image. Open its shared crop editor or use RECT x1 y1 x2 y2, POLYGON x y ..., ON, OFF or DELETE. Coordinates are local image fractions 0..1. A simple nonempty polygon with 3..128 vertices is required. Sources are unchanged; crop follows image transforms, affects rendering/selection/snapping, and persists through clipboard/archive/PDF. One undo step.

name: IMAGEADJUST
description: Select one unlocked reference image. Open the shared image editor or apply BRIGHTNESS value or CONTRAST value (0..200, neutral 100), MONO ON/OFF, KEY #rrggbb [tolerance 0..100], KEY OFF, or RESET. Keying compares original 8-bit RGB channels before colour adjustments; tolerance bounds the difference on each channel. Edits are nondestructive per-entity adjustments, preserve embedded source bytes, and use one undo step. Model/layout rendering, clipboard SVG and PDF output retain the adjustments.

name: REGION
description: Create one independent region from selected closed curves or unbranched closed chains; sources are preserved. With no selection or input PICK, use a point action or x,y input to detect a bounded area and its immediate islands. Native loops define an even-odd planar interior. Supports move/rotate/scale/mirror, selection, clipboard, persistence and EXPLODE. Escape cancels a pending pick; creation is one undo step. Detection limits match HATCH PICK.

name: BOUNDARY
description: Pick an enclosed area using a point action or x,y input. Creates independent closed native polylines for the outer loop and immediate islands on the active visible unlocked layer, preserving source objects. Uses visible finite curves; rejects gaps, duplicate overlaps, edge picks and over-budget arrangements. Limits match HATCH PICK. One undo step; Escape cancels.

name: SELECT
description: Activate selection. Prefer the selection argument to select known entity IDs.

name: LINE
description: Draw connected line segments. Send point actions for vertices and Escape to end the chain.

name: XLINE
description: Create a persistent infinite construction line from an origin and a direction point. Two point actions commit one entity; Escape cancels an unfinished entity.

name: RAY
description: Create a persistent ray from its origin through a direction point. Two point actions commit one entity; Escape cancels an unfinished entity.

name: RECTANGLE
description: Draw a rectangle with corner, dimension, area, rotation, chamfer, fillet, or line-width options.

name: HATCH
description: Create an associative hatch from selected closed curves or unbranched endpoint-connected curves. With no selection, or input prefixed PICK, pick an interior point (point action or x,y input). Escape cancels. Detection rejects open, overlapping or over-budget arrangements; capped at 256 input pieces, 2048 edges and 32768 samples. Input SOLID, LINES spacing angle, CROSS spacing angle, GRADIENT #rrggbb angle or RADIAL #rrggbb. Even-odd loops preserve islands. Maximum 512 native boundary parts. Selection is retained as source IDs; source edits refresh boundaries in the same history step.

name: HATCHEDIT
description: Edit one selected hatch in the shared panel. Accepts SOLID, LINES spacing angle, CROSS spacing angle, GRADIENT/RADIAL #rrggbb angle, ORIGIN x y, or DETACH. Pattern spacing and origin use metres. Locked hatches cannot be changed.

name: SOLID
description: Create a solid fill from the selected closed boundary curves, retaining source associations and islands.

name: GRADIENT
description: Create a gradient fill from the selected closed boundary curves. HATCHEDIT controls gradient type, end colour and angle; the start colour is the entity/layer colour.

name: HATCHTOBACK
description: Move selected hatches behind other drawing objects; with no hatch selected, moves all editable hatches. One undo step.

name: SPLINEDIT
description: Select one native cubic spline or all-cubic compound path. Opens its shared control-coordinate panel with a span selector. Optional CONTROL span control x y edits one control using one-based indices (controls 1..4) in one undo step. Connected joints move together; existing smooth tangent ratios are preserved. Locked objects cannot be edited. POINT index x y edits a retained fit point or B-spline vertex; KNOT index value edits a normalized parameter/knot (0..1). TANGENT START/END dx dy sets the endpoint derivative in metres per normalized parameter; FIT also accepts TANGENT START/END NATURAL. BEZIER discards the definition without changing geometry. CONTROL edits also detach it. INSERT index x y / REMOVE index change definition points and rebuild parameters. INSERTKNOT value refines CONTROL exactly. CONTROL with no arguments converts cubic spans exactly; FIT refits through span endpoints or an open point polyline (changes shape); POLYLINE tolerance converts to straight segments within tolerance in metres. Limits: 128 definition points, 4096 polyline vertices, depth 20. All indices start at 1.

name: SPLINE
description: Draw a cubic spline with FIT (natural chord-length interpolation, at least 2 points) or CONTROL/CV (clamped uniform B-spline, at least 4 control vertices). Point actions append up to 128 points; Enter or DONE commits exactly the clicked points as editable native Bezier spans plus their fit/control definition and normalized knots in one undo step. Escape discards the preview; changing mode restarts it.

name: ELLIPSE
description: Create an ellipse: AXIS uses two axis endpoints then a perpendicular radius point; CENTER uses centre, axis endpoint and radius point. ARC or CENTERARC adds start and end direction points. CW/CCW sets arc direction. Escape cancels; one completed ellipse is one undo step.

name: CIRCLE
description: Draw a circle using centre-radius, two-point, three-point, tangent-tangent-radius, or tangent-tangent-tangent construction.

name: POLYGON
description: Draw a regular polygon from its centre and radius, with a side count and inscribed or circumscribed mode.

name: ARC
description: Draw an arc using start-end-point-on-arc, start-centre-end, start-end-radius, or start-centre-angle construction.

name: TEXT
description: Create single-line text from a paper-space or model-space frame, then edit it in place.

name: MTEXT
description: Create a wrapping multiline text frame and open the rich in-place editor.

name: TEXTEDIT
description: Open the rich in-place editor for the selected text entity.

name: STYLE
description: Open the reusable named text-style manager.

name: CREATIONPANEL
description: Open the reusable creation panel for one selected rectangle, circle, regular polygon, arc, ellipse, single-span spline, or text entity.

name: PAN
description: Activate manual canvas panning.

name: ORTHO
description: Toggle persistent orthogonal point constraint, or pass 1/0 to enable/disable it. Shift temporarily inverts the current mode for point actions.

name: POLAR
description: Toggle polar tracking. Numeric input configures and enables it: the first value is the increment in degrees and remaining values are additional angles.

name: OTRACK
description: Toggle acquired object-snap tracking paths, or pass 1/0 to enable/disable them.

name: DSETTINGS
description: Open the drafting settings panel for polar angles and parallel, perpendicular, and tangent object-tracking relations.

name: TRACKPOINT
description: Acquire the next point as a temporary tracking origin without advancing the active drawing or modification command.

name: DYNMODE
description: Toggle in-canvas dynamic precision input, or pass ON/OFF or 1/0 to set it explicitly.

name: QUICKCALC
description: Evaluate a safe arithmetic and unit expression, optionally assigning a reusable session variable with name = expression.

name: LAYOUT
description: Open paper space, or create a layout from a named standard arrangement.

name: PAGESETUP
description: Open the active layout page-setup controls for paper, margins, and reusable profiles.

name: PSETUPIN
description: Import reusable page-setup profiles from another LUMCAD drawing.

name: PSETOUT
description: Export reusable page-setup profiles to a portable LUMCAD setup drawing.

name: MODEL
description: Switch from a layout to model space.

name: PSPACE
description: Switch to the active paper-space layout.

name: MVIEW
description: Open the active layout and create a rectangular viewport. Point coordinates use layout millimetres.

name: VPCLIP
description: Apply or edit a polygonal clip boundary on the selected layout viewport.

name: VPLAYER
description: Open per-viewport layer visibility and colour, linetype, and lineweight overrides.

name: VPMAX
description: Maximise the selected paper-space viewport for model navigation.

name: VPMIN
description: Return from a maximised viewport to the full paper layout.

name: OFFSET
description: Offset selected lines, construction lines, rays, polylines, rectangles, polygons, circles, arcs, or ellipses by distance or through a point, with erase/keep and destination-layer options. Ellipses produce adaptive cubic paths; singular inward offsets are rejected.

name: TRIM
description: Trim selected or visible curves. Pick a target portion, draw a cutting fence, or hold Shift on a target point to temporarily extend instead.

name: EXTEND
description: Extend the picked endpoint of a line, arc, or open path to the nearest valid boundary. Hold Shift to temporarily trim instead.

name: COPY
description: Copy selected entities from a base point to one or more destinations.

name: COPYBASE
description: Copy the selected geometry and its dependencies to the operating-system clipboard using a picked base point.

name: COPYCLIP
description: Copy the selected geometry and its dependencies to the operating-system clipboard.

name: CUTCLIP
description: Copy selected geometry to the operating-system clipboard and delete it only after the clipboard write succeeds.

name: PASTECLIP
description: Read supported LUMCAD or SVG geometry from rich or plain-text clipboard interchange and place it at a picked insertion point.

name: PASTEORIG
description: Paste LUMCAD clipboard geometry at its original drawing coordinates.

name: PASTEBLOCK
description: Paste supported clipboard geometry as one anonymous block reference at a picked insertion point.

name: MOVE
description: Move selected entities from a base point to a destination.

name: ROTATE
description: Rotate or copy selected entities around a base point using a pointer, configured numeric angle, or source/target reference directions.

name: SCALE
description: Scale or copy selected entities around a base point using a uniform factor, separate X/Y factors, or reference lengths.

name: MIRROR
description: Mirror selected entities across a two-point symmetry axis, with copy/replace and configurable text-glyph reflection.

name: ARRAY
description: Start an immediate rectangular array preview from selected entities with automatic spacing and default counts. Adjust BASE, XSPACING, YSPACING, COLUMNS or ROWS, then submit empty input to create; cancel to discard.

name: ARRAYPOLAR
description: Select a motif, pick or type the center, then edit a polar array preview. COUNT 1..100, ANGLE -360..360 (nonzero), ROTATEITEMS 0/1 and CENTER x,y adjust it. Full turns omit a duplicate last item; partial sweeps include both ends. Enter or ARRAYCLOSE commits. ARRAYEDIT reopens saved parameters.

name: ARRAYPATH
description: Select a motif then pick a separate connected curve/path (point action with targetId). COUNT divides its length evenly; SPACING fills it at a fixed metre interval (maximum 100 items). OFFSET, BASE, ALIGNITEMS 0/1, REVERSE and PATH edit the preview. Enter/ARRAYCLOSE commits; ARRAYEDIT reopens. Source path edits update the array in the same undo step. Moving only the array detaches its source while preserving editable parameters.

name: ARRAYEDIT
description: Select one rectangular array to edit its origin, spacing and counts with the same preview as ARRAY. Enter or ARRAYCLOSE commits one undoable edit; Escape cancels. Keeps the array entity ID.

name: ARRAYCLOSE
description: Commit the current array creation or edit preview. Send as input while ARRAY or ARRAYEDIT is active.

name: BREAK
description: Break a picked line, arc, circle, or path between two points while preserving native curve parts.

name: BREAKATPOINT
description: Split a picked open curve at one point without removing an interval.

name: STRETCH
description: Stretch the control points captured by a crossing window from a base point to a destination.

name: LENGTHEN
description: Lengthen or shorten the picked end of an open line, arc, or path by delta, percent, total, or dynamic value.

name: JOIN
description: Join endpoint-connected lines, arcs, ellipses, splines, or paths into one exact ordered mixed path.

name: EXPLODE
description: Explode selected compound paths, blocks, hatches, text, or dimensions into editable parts.

name: XPLODE
description: Explode selected compound objects with explicit per-part or parent property handling.

name: ALIGN
description: Align selected objects from two or three source/destination point pairs, with optional uniform scaling.

name: FILLET
description: Create a tangent radius fillet between picked curve branches, including zero-radius cleanup and polyline or multiple modes.

name: CHAMFER
description: Create a bevel between picked curve branches using two distances or distance and angle, including polyline or multiple modes.

name: BLEND
description: Create a cubic spline blend tangent to the picked endpoints of two open curves.

name: DIMENSION
description: Create an adaptive associative dimension or a free dimension between two points.

name: DIMLINEAR
description: Create a horizontal or vertical linear dimension independent of the measured segment angle.

name: DIMALIGNED
description: Create a linear dimension aligned with the measured segment.

name: DIMROTATED
description: Create a linear dimension along a typed rotation angle in degrees.

name: DIMANGULAR
description: Dimension the angle of an arc, two selected lines, or three picked points.

name: DIMARC
description: Create an associative length dimension for a selected or picked circular or elliptical arc. The value follows the source curve; the position grip adjusts annotation offset.

name: DIMRADIUS
description: Create a radius dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIMDIAMETER
description: Create a diameter dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIMJOGGED
description: Create a jogged-radius dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIMORDINATE
description: Create an X or Y ordinate dimension from the drawing origin.

name: QDIM
description: Create a continuous series by default, or use QDIM BASELINE FIRST/LAST, for the selected dimensionable entities in one undoable operation.

name: DIMBASELINE
description: Create a baseline series from selected linear geometry or dimensions; append FIRST or LAST to choose the reference end.

name: DIMCONTINUE
description: Create continued chain dimensions from selected linear geometry or dimensions.

name: CENTERMARK
description: Create an associative centre mark on a selected or picked circle or arc.

name: DELETE
description: Delete the selected editable entities.

name: UNDO
description: Undo the latest document change.

name: REDO
description: Redo the latest undone document change.

name: SAVEAS
description: Open the native Save As dialog for the active drawing.

name: NEW
description: Create a new drawing, prompting to save unsaved work when necessary.

name: OPEN
description: Open the native .lcad file chooser.

name: PLOT
description: Open the plot preview for the active layout with area, scale, margins, style, and quality controls.

name: PDF
description: Preview and write the active layout directly to a deterministic PDF file.

name: PDFALL
description: Preview and write every layout, including mixed paper sizes, as one ordered PDF.

name: PDFSELECTED
description: Preview and write the currently selected layout tabs as one ordered PDF.

name: PUBLISH
description: Open the multi-layout publication preview for all layouts.

name: AUTOPUBLISH
description: Publish all layouts without a dialog to a PDF beside the saved .lcad drawing.

name: DWFXOUT
description: Preview and publish all layouts as a multi-sheet DWFx/XPS package.

name: ZOOM
description: Set a relative zoom factor using a numeric command input.

name: EXTENTS
description: Fit all visible drawing content in the canvas.
